newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil steady, barges bid up towards $85.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil steady, barges bid up towards $85.

text.p: Fuel oil was steady on Monday in thin business, with barges bid up by one or two players but not holding onto higher prices.
One deal was heard done at $85 fob, another at $84.50 fob ARA but the majority of business was at $84 fob, traders said.
"I think its being bid up by someone," said one trader. "Crude was stronger today but bunker demand was still three times zero."
The little lift in price failed to transfer to high sulphur cargoes, where prompt demand was minimal and suppliers kept to the shadows.
Low sulphur was slightly up, eyeing crude's strength, after swaps gained $1, but traders said the grade's fundamentals were still bearish.
A U.S. refiner was heard to have bought a top-up low sulphur cracked cargo late on Friday, on a half floating, half fixed price basis, from a U.K. refiner for a requirement into Italy.
An Italian trader was heard to have bought from northern France on Friday but the price was not known.
